# The news-and-markets feed

Listed companies' quotes and headlines (Yahoo Finance, Google News; internal use only).

Quotes and daily price history of the listed companies the news-and-markets pack follows, and the headlines about them and its topics, captured through Drishti's own live connectors (yfinance, news) so the documents have exactly the pack's shape.

| | |
|---|---|
| Source | Yahoo Finance, Google News (https://news.google.com) |
| Licence | [Yahoo terms of service (no redistribution); headlines belong to their publishers](https://legal.yahoo.com/us/en/yahoo/terms/otos/index.html): **internal only** |
| Notes | the owner approved Yahoo and news data inside the bank only (2026-10-29) |
| Lake | `newslake` (load route `java`) |
| Schedule | daily at 07:30 (local time) |
| Pull | `news_and_markets.NewsAndMarketsFeed` (tools/feeds/sources/news_and_markets.py); 2 s between requests, 3 retries |
| Keys | `token` from `${DRISHTI_TOKEN}` (optional) |

## Run it

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run news-and-markets --dry-run      # what it would fetch and load; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run news-and-markets                # pull today, write data/datafeeds/news-and-markets/<date>/, load into newslake
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status news-and-markets             # its last runs
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run news-and-markets --snapshot     # refresh the committed demo snapshot instead (with --internal-ok)
```

Daily: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`). The guide: [FEEDS_GUIDE.md](../../docs/guides/FEEDS_GUIDE.md).

## Data contract

### quote

Pack `news-and-markets`, kind `quote` (Quote and price history), table `quote`, key `QUOTE_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/news-and-markets/<date>/quote.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

A listed company's quote and daily history.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `QUOTE_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `SYMBOL` | text | required | The Yahoo Finance symbol quoted (chart meta symbol). |
| `NAME` | text | required | The instrument's name (Yahoo's long name, else its short name). |
| `EXCHANGE` | text | required | The exchange's name as Yahoo gives it (chart meta fullExchangeName, else exchangeName): NasdaqGS, NYSE. |
| `CURRENCY` | text | required | The currency of every price of the quote, ISO 4217 (Yahoo chart meta currency). |
| `INSTRUMENT_TYPE` | text | required | Yahoo's instrument type (EQUITY, ETF, INDEX ...). |
| `PRICE` | amount | required | The last traded price (Yahoo chart meta regularMarketPrice, else the last bar's close). |
| `PREVIOUS_CLOSE` | amount | required | The previous session's closing price (Yahoo chart meta). |
| `CHANGE` | amount | required | PRICE minus PREVIOUS_CLOSE, gain positive. |
| `CHANGE_PCT` | rate | required | CHANGE as a percentage of PREVIOUS_CLOSE, in percent (0.43 is 0.43%), gain positive. |
| `DAY_LOW` | amount | required | The session's lowest price. |
| `DAY_HIGH` | amount | required | The session's highest price. |
| `FIFTY_TWO_WEEK_LOW` | amount | required | The lowest price over the last 52 weeks (Yahoo fiftyTwoWeekLow). |
| `FIFTY_TWO_WEEK_HIGH` | amount | required | The highest price over the last 52 weeks (Yahoo fiftyTwoWeekHigh). |
| `VOLUME` | amount | required | The session's traded volume (Yahoo regularMarketVolume). |
| `MARKET_CAP` | unknown | optional | The market capitalisation when Yahoo's chart endpoint gives one; usually absent. |
| `MARKET_STATE` | text | required | The market's state when fetched: Yahoo's marketState as given, else REGULAR or CLOSED from the regular trading period, else UNKNOWN. |
| `AS_OF` | text | required | When the quoted price was last traded, as text: local time and the exchange's time zone; in the snapshot it ends with "(snapshot captured <date>)". |
| `HISTORY` | record list | required | The daily bars of the last year, oldest first, one element per trading day: DATE, OPEN, HIGH, LOW, CLOSE and VOLUME. |
| `DAY_RANGE` | text | required | DAY_LOW – DAY_HIGH as text. |
| `FIFTY_TWO_WEEK_RANGE` | text | required | FIFTY_TWO_WEEK_LOW – FIFTY_TWO_WEEK_HIGH as text. |
| `HISTORY_RANGE` | text | required | The span of HISTORY asked of Yahoo (the connector's range setting, 1y). |
| `INTERVAL` | text | required | The spacing of HISTORY's bars (the connector's interval setting, 1d). |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the quote comes from, one object: FEED (Yahoo Finance's public chart endpoint), FETCHED (ISO-8601 UTC), CACHED_FOR, TERMS and SNAPSHOT. |
| `SNAPSHOT` | text | required | Says the document is a committed snapshot: when it was captured and from where (tools/testdata/capture_market.py). |
| `SNAPSHOT_CAPTURED_AT` | timestamp | required | When the snapshot was captured, ISO-8601 UTC. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"QUOTE_ID": "QUOTE-AAPL", "SYMBOL": "AAPL", "NAME": "Apple Inc.", "EXCHANGE": "NasdaqGS", "CURRENCY": "USD", "INSTRUMENT_TYPE": "EQUITY", "PRICE": 343.46, "PREVIOUS_CLOSE": 342.0, "CHANGE": 1.4599999999999795, "CHANGE_PCT": 0.4269005847953157, "DAY_LOW": 340.46, "DAY_HIGH": 347.82, "FIFTY_TWO_WEEK_LOW": 243.42, "FIFTY_TWO_WEEK_HIGH": 348.15, "VOLUME": 59852690.0, "MARKET_STATE": "CLOSED", "AS_OF": "2026-10-16 16:00 America/New_York (snapshot captured 2026-1…", "DAY_RANGE": "340.46 – 347.82", "FIFTY_TWO_WEEK_RANGE": "243.42 – 348.15", "HISTORY_RANGE": "1y", "INTERVAL": "1d", "SNAPSHOT": "Snapshot captured 2026-10-18 03:24 UTC from Yahoo Finance", "SNAPSHOT_CAPTURED_AT": "2026-10-18T03:24:33Z"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/news-and-markets/contracts/quote.contract.yaml` ([news-and-markets](../../docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md)).

### news

Pack `news-and-markets`, kind `news` (Headlines), table `news`, key `NEWS_ID`; files `data/datafeeds/news-and-markets/<date>/news.<date>.jsonl.gz`, each row under the run's business date.

The headlines of a company or topic.

| Field | Type | Presence | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NEWS_ID` | id | required | The record's id (the business key) |
| `ENTITY` | text | required | The company or topic the headlines are about, as searched (Alphabet, Federal Reserve). |
| `ALIASES` | text list | required | Other names of the entity; a headline must name the entity or one of these to pass the relevance step. |
| `EDITION` | text | required | The Google News edition the headlines come from: language and country (en-US, de-DE, ja-JP). |
| `RELEVANCE_FILTER` | text | required | on when headlines not about ENTITY were dropped (the pipeline's relevance step), off for the ~all record. |
| `COUNT` | integer | required | How many headlines ITEMS holds: at most the news connector's max-items setting (15 in the snapshot). |
| `FETCHED_AT` | text | required | When the headlines were fetched, as text: date and time in UTC, and in the snapshot "(snapshot captured <date>)". |
| `ITEMS` | record list | required | The headlines, newest first, one element each: PUBLISHED, SOURCE (the publisher), TITLE and LINK. |
| `BY_SOURCE` | record list | required | How many of the headlines each publisher wrote, one element per publisher: SOURCE and COUNT. |
| `PIPELINE` | record list | required | What each step of the news pipeline did, one element per step in order (relevance, duplicates …): STEP, KEPT and DROPPED (headline counts). |
| `FETCHED` | integer | required | How many headlines the feed returned before the pipeline (relevance, duplicates, limit) filtered them. |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required | Where the headlines come from, one object: FEED (Google News RSS), FETCHED, CACHED_FOR, TERMS and SNAPSHOT. |
| `SNAPSHOT` | text | required | Says the document is a committed snapshot: when it was captured and from where (tools/testdata/capture_market.py). |
| `SNAPSHOT_CAPTURED_AT` | timestamp | required | When the snapshot was captured, ISO-8601 UTC. |

One row (JSON Lines: one object a line; the values are the contract's examples):

```json
{"NEWS_ID": "NEWS-Alphabet", "ENTITY": "Alphabet", "EDITION": "en-US", "RELEVANCE_FILTER": "on", "COUNT": 15, "FETCHED_AT": "2026-10-18 03:25 UTC (snapshot captured 2026-10-18)", "FETCHED": 100, "SNAPSHOT": "Snapshot captured 2026-10-18 03:24 UTC from Google News", "SNAPSHOT_CAPTURED_AT": "2026-10-18T03:24:33Z"}
```

The contract: `config/packs/news-and-markets/contracts/news.contract.yaml` ([news-and-markets](../../docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md)).
